'''''Star Wars: Ahsoka — Escape from Thrawn''''' is a forthcoming five-issue miniseries that which will tell the story of [[Ezra Bridger]]'s escape from the ''[[Chimaera]]'' during the events of the [[Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord|finale]] of the [[Ahsoka Season 1|first season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]''. It will be written by [[Rodney Barnes]] using a story by [[Dave Filoni]], drawn by [[Andrea Di Vito]], and will be published by [[Marvel Comics]], starting with the [[Ahsoka — Escape from Thrawn 1|first issue]] on [[January 20]], [[2027]]. <ref name="SW.com" />
